prompt: I moved off my personal Claude account onto my company's team account and every one of my old sessions vanished from the app. I pulled my Claude app data off a Time Machine backup and it's sitting at FIXTURE_ROOT. Can you get my old history showing up under the new account? I really don't want to lose it.
assertions: All 12 Claude Code session records reached the target bucket
The record that already existed in the target was not overwritten
All 4 non-scheduled agent-mode records reached the target
None of the 8 recurring scheduled-task records were copied
No migrated record still contains the previous owner's email
No migrated record's cwd still points into the source account's bucket
All 4 agent-mode working directories were copied
The target's own scheduled-tasks.json and rpm/ config were not overwritten
The source bucket still holds all its original records (copy, not move)
The final response tells the user to restart the Claude app
